Subject: POC: Success criteria & KPIs — follow-up and next steps (Atlas Payments)

Hi Emily / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we finalize the POC scope: 

Scope (what we'll evaluate)
- Primary flows: customer support triage (intent classification + suggested responses) and billing reconciliation summarization.
- Data: subset of production tickets and ledger extracts (anonymized) that you will provide; initial eval set ~500 items.

Initial success criteria / KPIs (proposed)
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 300ms for 2k token max prompt (single-turn).
- Throughput: sustained 50 requests/sec with 2 concurrent workers on the test harness.
- Cost: average cost/token target <= $0.0008 for serving config used in POC.
- Quality: intent accuracy >= 90% on gold set; response correctness >= 92% on the summarization set; hallucination rate < 3%.

Evaluation plan & ownership
- Week 0 (this week): finalize NDA/POC agreement and share Sanity Test data. (Owner: Jordan)
- Week 1: environment setup + model integration (Redwood + Atlas infra access), sample data ingestion, baseline eval. (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 2: tuned runs, perf profiling (latency/throughput), and cost modeling. (Owners: Marissa, Ava)
- Week 3: quality validation with blind eval set, regression checks, and tooling handoff. (Owners: Atlas + Marissa)
- Week 4: recap, recommended configuration for production, and next steps (Dedicated or Hosted).

Ask: can you confirm the sample dataset availability and whether SOC 2 evidence or additional compliance artifacts are required before we begin? I've attached a draft POC test plan and our standard POC terms for review.

If that looks good I will schedule a 30m kickoff for Monday 5/27 to lock in access and owners.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the plan. High level: Atlas is definitely interested in validating both the triage and summarization flows. A couple of items to tighten before we commit to dates:

- Latency: for the triage flow our customer SLAs expect p95 < 200ms for 512-token prompts; can you run a 512-token target in parallel with the 2k token runs so we can validate both tails?
- Throughput: we typically see burst windows up to 120 rps in peak trading hours; we need to understand graceful degradation/burst handling beyond sustained throughput.
- Compliance: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an outline of your data retention/segmentation options before we get team access.

We'll prepare the anonymized sample set (500 tickets + 150 ledgers) and share via the secure S3 link by EOD Friday.

Assignees on our side: I'll coordinate data and product questions; Carlos will validate throughput/ops needs.

Emily
Director, Product — Billing & Risk
Emily Chen | emily.chen@atlaspayments.com

Appreciate the details — we can absolutely include a 512-token latency run and will add burst testing to the perf plan to simulate your 120 rps peak windows. A few operational notes from our side:

- SOC 2: attaching a checklist and the PDF for our SOC 2 scope; we can provide the Type II report after we complete the vendor auth redaction.
- Data access: secure S3 with temporary read-only creds is perfect. Please send the bucket + manifest (CSV) and we'll pull the sample into the POC staging environment.
- Eval sets: please include a labeled gold set for both flows (intent labels + expected response). If you don't have one we can help label a subset (we charge a small label ops fee).

Attached: evaluation_template.csv — this is the format we use for blind evals (id, prompt, gold_label, gold_response, notes).

Suggested tweaks to KPIs (operational focus)
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for 512-token prompts; p95 <= 350ms for 2k-token prompts during steady state. We'll capture cold-start and warm KV-cache runs separately.
- Throughput: baseline sustained 50 rps; include burst tests up to 150 rps with graceful degradation callbacks.
- Cost modeling: we'll provide an expected cost/token report per config; goal is to identify a production sweet spot that meets your SLA while keeping cost predictable.

I'll block time for a kickoff 5/27 10am PT unless you prefer another slot.

Thanks,

Emily / Carlos —

Thanks — updated plan below reflecting Marissa's operational input and your throughput ask:

Updated Success Criteria / KPIs for POC
- Latency:
  - 512-token p95 <= 200ms (target) — measured during warm-state runs.
  - 2k-token p95 <= 300ms (target) — measured during steady-state.
  - We'll report cold-start and warm-cache metrics separately.
- Throughput:
  - Sustained baseline: 50 rps
  - Burst window: validated up to 150 rps with graceful degradation; expected fallbacks documented.
- Cost:
  - Target average cost/token <= $0.0006 for the production-like config we recommend after tuning.
  - We'll provide a cost sensitivity table per model/quantization option.
- Quality:
  - Intent accuracy >= 94% on gold set (classification).
  - Summarization correctness >= 94% (human-evaluated on blind set).
  - Hallucination rate < 1.5% on the blind evaluation.

Evaluation Plan (detailed)
- Deliverables we will provide: perf report (latency/throughput), cost model, detailed evaluation sheet with per-sample pass/fail, and recommended production config.
- Timeline: kickoff 2029-05-27, baseline results by 2029-06-03, tuned runs by 2029-06-10, final recap 2029-06-17.

Action items
- Atlas: share S3 manifest + sample link (Emily) — due 2029-05-17 EOD.

- Slack channel: I'll create a dedicated channel for run logs and fast coordination.
